description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Zed''' restores [[File:Energy icon.svg|15px|link=Energy]] energy whenever he and his [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' or multiple ''Shadows'' hit an ability on the same target. This may only occur once per cast ability.
description.text: Passive: Zed restores  energy whenever he and his Shadows or multiple Shadows hit an ability on the same target. This may only occur once per cast ability.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Zed''' creates a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' that dashes to the target location and remains there for 5.25 seconds, being able to mimic ''[[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]]'' and ''[[File:Zed Shadow Slash.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Shadow Slash|An icon for Zed's ability Shadow Slash]] [[Zed#Shadow Slash|Shadow Slash]]'' regardless of range. ''Living Shadow'' can be recast while within range of the ''Shadow''.
description2.text: Active: Zed creates a Shadow that dashes to the target location and remains there for 5.25 seconds, being able to mimic Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash regardless of range. Living Shadow can be recast while within range of the Shadow.

description3.raw: '''Recast - Shadow Swap:''' '''Zed''' and the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blink]] to swap places.
description3.text: Recast - Shadow Swap: Zed and the Shadow blink to swap places.

description4.raw: ''If an ability is cast while the Shadow is dashing, it will cast that ability once it has been placed. See [[Zed#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Shadows.''
description4.text: If an ability is cast while the Shadow is dashing, it will cast that ability once it has been placed. See Pets for more details about Shadows.

30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50

notes.raw: * '''Zed''' gains a buff for 5.25 seconds that indicates and determines the duration in which he may recast ''Living Shadow''. ** The buff is granted briefly after ''Living Shadow'' is cast. *** If cast at minimum distance, the buff and the ''Shadow's'' individual durations will effectively start at the same time. *** If cast at greater than the minimum distance, then the buff's duration will start before the ''Shadow's'' duration. * The passive is available while the ability has not been learned. It will grant the [[File:Energy icon.svg|15px|link=Energy]] energy refund strength at rank 1. * The [[File:Energy icon.svg|15px|link=Energy]] energy refund is not granted if the mimicked ability is blocked by a [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]]. * ''Living Shadow's'' recast can be queued to cast while the ''Shadow'' is dashing; the recast will occur once it has been placed. * ''Living Shadow'' cannot be recast while [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounded]] or [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooted]]. * If ''Living Shadow'' is recast during [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken's]] cast, '''Zed''' will instantly release the shuriken from the cast location of [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]] while still remaining in cast time. Once he has swapped places, he will then throw the shuriken that the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' would have thrown instead. ** '''Zed''' will cast [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]] as he normally would from the new location, but over the remaining cast time and towards the same point of cast. ** The [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' will not throw a shuriken from its new location, but will continue to play the cast animation for [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]]. ** This special interaction does not occur with the swap recast of [[File:Zed Death Mark 2.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Death Mark 2|An icon for Zed's ability Death Mark 2]] [[Zed#Death Mark 2|Death Mark]]; the recast will be buffered if used during [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken's]] cast. * '''Zed''' will swap places with the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' by all means if he buffers ''Living Shadow's'' recast during its dash.(unexpected) ** ''Living Shadow'' cannot be recast while '''Zed''' is marking his target with [[File:Zed Death Mark.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Death Mark|An icon for Zed's ability Death Mark]] [[Zed#Death Mark|Death Mark]], but may still be recast if it was buffered.(bug) * If '''Zed''' casts ''Living Shadow'' while a non-''[[File:Zed Death Mark 2.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Death Mark 2|An icon for Zed's ability Death Mark 2]] [[Zed#Death Mark 2|Death Mark]] Shadow'' is already present, the previous ''Shadow'' will instantly disappear. * If a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' expires while in the cast time of [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken]], the mimicked cast will be cancelled. * [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' will cast [[File:Zed Shadow Slash.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Shadow Slash|An icon for Zed's ability Shadow Slash]] [[Zed#Shadow Slash|Shadow Slash]] independently of being in [[File:Zed Razor Shuriken.png|20xpx|border|link=Zed#Razor Shuriken|An icon for Zed's ability Razor Shuriken]] [[Zed#Razor Shuriken|Razor Shuriken's]] cast time or not.(unexpected) * [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' spawned from ''Living Shadow'' may sometimes last for up to an additional 0.25 seconds.(bug) * [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' will not disappear when '''Zed''' dies.(bug)
notes.text:
Zed gains a buff for 5.25 seconds that indicates and determines the duration in which he may recast Living Shadow.
* The buff is granted briefly after Living Shadow is cast.
** If cast at minimum distance, the buff and the Shadow's individual durations will effectively start at the same time.
** If cast at greater than the minimum distance, then the buff's duration will start before the Shadow's duration.
The passive is available while the ability has not been learned. It will grant the  energy refund strength at rank 1.
The  energy refund is not granted if the mimicked ability is blocked by a spell shield.
Living Shadow's recast can be queued to cast while the Shadow is dashing; the recast will occur once it has been placed.
Living Shadow cannot be recast while grounded or rooted.
If Living Shadow is recast during Razor Shuriken's cast, Zed will instantly release the shuriken from the cast location of Razor Shuriken while still remaining in cast time. Once he has swapped places, he will then throw the shuriken that the Shadow would have thrown instead.
* Zed will cast Razor Shuriken as he normally would from the new location, but over the remaining cast time and towards the same point of cast.
* The Shadow will not throw a shuriken from its new location, but will continue to play the cast animation for Razor Shuriken.
* This special interaction does not occur with the swap recast of Death Mark; the recast will be buffered if used during Razor Shuriken's cast.
Zed will swap places with the Shadow by all means if he buffers Living Shadow's recast during its dash.(unexpected)
* Living Shadow cannot be recast while Zed is marking his target with Death Mark, but may still be recast if it was buffered.(bug)
If Zed casts Living Shadow while a non- Death Mark Shadow is already present, the previous Shadow will instantly disappear.
If a Shadow expires while in the cast time of Razor Shuriken, the mimicked cast will be cancelled.
Shadows will cast Shadow Slash independently of being in Razor Shuriken's cast time or not.(unexpected)
Shadows spawned from Living Shadow may sometimes last for up to an additional 0.25 seconds.(bug)
Shadows will not disappear when Zed dies.(bug)
